import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { generateKeyPairSync, sign } from 'node:crypto'

const { privateKey, publicKey } = generateKeyPairSync('rsa', { modulusLength: 2048 })
const origin = 'http://localhost:3078'
process.env.REMIX_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY = `pk_test_${Buffer.from('clerk.example.com$').toString('base64')}`
process.env.CLERK_SECRET_KEY = 'sk_test_local_runtime_verification'
process.env.CLERK_JWT_KEY = publicKey.export({ type: 'spki', format: 'pem' }).toString()
process.env.CLERK_AUTHORIZED_PARTIES = origin
const { authenticate } = await import('./src/server/clerk/auth.ts')
const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)
function token(user, overrides = {}) {
  const encoded = [
    Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ alg: 'RS256', typ: 'JWT', kid: 'local-runtime' })).toString(
      'base64url',
    ),
    Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify({
        sub: user,
        sid: 'sess_runtime',
        iss: 'https://clerk.example.com',
        azp: origin,
        iat: now,
        nbf: now - 5,
        exp: now + 300,
        ...overrides,
      }),
    ).toString('base64url'),
  ].join('.')
  return `${encoded}.${sign('RSA-SHA256', Buffer.from(encoded), privateKey).toString('base64url')}`
}
const ids = ['user_casey', 'user_morgan']
assert.deepEqual(
  (
    await Promise.all(
      ids.map((user) =>
        authenticate(
          new Request(`${origin}/api/session`, {
            headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token(user)}` },
          }),
        ),
      ),
    )
  ).map((identity) => identity.userId),
  ids,
)
assert.equal((await authenticate(new Request(`${origin}/dashboard`))).userId, null)
for (const jwt of [
  token(ids[0], { exp: now - 300 }),
  token(ids[0], { azp: 'https://example.com' }),
  token(ids[0]).slice(0, -8) + 'tampered',
])
  assert.equal(
    (
      await authenticate(
        new Request(`${origin}/api/session`, { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${jwt}` } }),
      )
    ).userId,
    null,
  )
const { router } = await import('./src/router.tsx')
const convexToken = await router.fetch(`${origin}/api/convex-token`)
assert.equal(convexToken.status, process.env.EXPECT_CONVEX_TOKEN === '1' ? 200 : 404)
if (convexToken.status === 200) assert.deepEqual(await convexToken.json(), { token: null })
else
  assert.equal(
    (
      await router.fetch(
        new Request(`${origin}/api/convex-token`, {
          headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token(ids[0])}` },
        }),
      )
    ).status,
    404,
  )
const response = await router.fetch(
  new Request(`${origin}/api/session`, { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token(ids[0])}` } }),
)
assert.deepEqual(await response.json(), { userId: ids[0] })
assert.equal((await router.fetch(`${origin}/dashboard`)).status, 303)
const protectedPage = await router.fetch(
  new Request(`${origin}/dashboard`, { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token(ids[0])}` } }),
)
assert.equal(protectedPage.status, 200)
assert.ok((await protectedPage.text()).includes('Your account'))
const { assets } = await import('./src/assets.ts')
await assets.close()
